text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took Buena Vista to the infirmary, as 
she's been feeling a bit out of sorts 
lately.
choice_data_list:
Don't push yourself—just take it easy and 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'll make sure it heals 
completely. Please wait for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, where is this...? Huh, who's that 
over there—

text_block_list.name: Trainer in Dream
text_block_list.text: Buena…… are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Trainer in Dream
text_block_list.text: Buena…… are you alright?

*sniff*... S-Sorry... But... It felt like 
the sky was being mean to me... and 
Buu-chan got all lonely...

I need to do my best, and yet... *hic*, 
waaah...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!? All I did was get caught in the 
rain...! And calling yourself Boo-chan...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
This makes you look just like me back when 
I used to be a spoiled crybaby...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer in Dream
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, understood. In that case, let's 
switch to indoor training. Don't worry, 
I'll rethink the routine too.

text_block_list.name: Pampered Buena
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Yeah. Thank you, big brother...

text_block_list.name: Pampered Buena
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Yeah. Thank you, big sister...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! N-No way, absolutely not! This is 
supposed to be training, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hold back those lonely feelings! Just push 
through a little longer, me...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer in Dream
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? If there's something on your 
mind, you can tell me anything.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in Dream
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? If there's something on your 
mind, you can tell me anything.

text_block_list.name: Pampered Buena
text_block_list.text: ...Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Pampered Buena
text_block_list.text:
Buu-chan wants... to share an umbrella 
with you, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Pampered Buena
text_block_list.text:
Buu-chan wants... to share an umbrella 
with you, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Pampered Buena
text_block_list.text:
"I wondered if it might cheer me up... 
just like it always does."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
S-Stop it~! And here I'd decided I was 
done with that kind of stuff...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't believe I used to be such a 
spoiled crybaby back then.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But... you accepted me anyway. Didn't you, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I was able to move 
forward. I told myself I can't keep taking 
everyone's kindness for granted—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Nn... Wait, was that just—
choice_data_list: Good morning. Have any sweet dreams?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A good dream, huh... Ahaha, I wonder. 
Though I guess it felt kinda nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right, Trainer? ...I was able to grow this 
much all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It's nothing!
